title: Why AI Voice Feels More Human Than Ever

reader_summary.headline: We see a lot of businesses that are already doing thousands.
reader_summary.overview: We see a lot of businesses that are already doing thousands, tens of thousands of phone calls with AI every day. Any business that pays a person a hundred, 150K a year to answer phone calls is a potential customer of voice AI. I think the rules of the game are changing.

key_points.text: Do people really want to be friends with an AI?
key_points.evidence_quote: Do people really want to be friends with an AI?

key_points.text: Voice is a platform that we intuit to be more opinionated or we need to be more opinionated than let's say.
key_points.evidence_quote: Voice is a platform that we intuit to be more opinionated or we need to be more opinionated than let's say.

key_points.text: The type of and power of products you can build is also above anything that we've ever seen.
key_points.evidence_quote: The type of and power of products you can build is also above anything that we've ever seen.

thesis: The podcast argues that AI voice has reached a breakthrough moment because modern LLMs and speech-to-text technologies now work effectively, enabling natural conversations that feel more human than previous robotic attempts. It further posits that voice will become the primary way consumers interact with AI, driven by businesses adopting these efficient agents for thousands of daily calls and by the emotional engagement that occurs when users forget they are speaking to a machine.
